# IRONMAN identity review — 2026-10-22

Recommendation: all four held rows have sufficient evidence for CONFIRMED proposals. No proposals applied. Registry remains 56 CONFIRMED / 4 REVIEW / 0 UNRESOLVED. Proposed aggregate after separate owner approval: 60 CONFIRMED / 0 REVIEW / 0 UNRESOLVED.

| Ranking row | Proposed ID | Country | Proposal |
|---|---:|---|---|
| 2024 Men #8 Mathias Lyngsø Petersen | 100 | DEN → DK | CONFIRMED |
| 2024 Women #5 Maja Stage Nielsen | 10840 | DEN → DK | CONFIRMED |
| 2025 Women #10 Maja Stage Nielsen | 10840 | DEN → DK | CONFIRMED |
| 2025 Men #4 Nick Thompson | 10435 | AUS → AU | CONFIRMED |

## Mathias Lyngsø Petersen / ID 100

Local male profile Mathias Petersen, DK, 11 linked results. Existing owner-approved mapping dated 2026-10-19 points to https://stats.protriathletes.org/athlete/mathias-lyngsoe-petersen . The archived profile HTML explicitly names **Mathias Lyngsoe Petersen** in its biography heading and paragraph, bridging the shortened profile headline and the standings name. The ø/oe spelling is considered for this evidenced alias only; no global normalization change is proposed.

Evidence file: /Users/andrey.shubin/Projects/tri-app-archives/pto-photo-cohort-2026-10-20/100.html

SHA-256: 85958bc5566e09eb4ae4b022a25909fb2add0c7d81a8f3ba40ba7f0550a23e9a — matches existing approved mapping. Observed 2026-10-19T13:37:35.191Z; read-only reinspection 2026-10-22. Existing fixture retains nine matching result tuples, including Kalmar 2026 #17 7:55:06 (result 4101), Texas 2026 #24 7:57:58 (3523), Marbella 2025 #32 3:59:14 (2820). Registry tests revalidate tuple linkage and splits. Evidence is not merely a name or slug similarity.

## Maja Stage Nielsen / ID 10840

Local female profile, DK, 13 linked results. No entry in the 221 approved PTO enrichment mappings; absence there is not an identity rejection. Existing photo discovery (2026-09-24T13:34:02.563Z) recorded a verified canonical profile and headline. Its LOW/REVIEW concerned shared photo assets, not proof of a different athlete; photo scoring is not used for confirmation.

Read-only official [PTO profile](https://stats.protriathletes.org/athlete/maja-stage-nielsen) accessed through web tool on 2026-10-22 (tool reports crawl last week) corroborates name, Denmark and these independent historical results:

| Local result | Season / race | Place | Swim | Bike | Run | Total |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 2767 | 2025 70.3 World Championship | 28 | 28:25 | 2:44:19 | 1:26:28 | 4:42:25 |
| 2704 | 2025 Hawaii | 19 | 55:40 | 4:57:00 | 3:16:11 | 9:15:07 |
| 2505 | 2025 Lake Placid | 13 | 58:14 | 5:07:32 | 3:17:34 | 9:30:41 |

All tuples match current local ID 10840. No new raw HTML snapshot or HTML hash claimed for this web-tool observation. These are identity corroboration, not standings point verification or a new PTO URL approval.

## Nick Thompson / ID 10435

Local male profile, AU, 13 linked results. Existing src/data/athletes/countryEnrichment.json records verified https://stats.protriathletes.org/athlete/nick-thompson , Australia, checked 2026-09-27, with historical review 2026-10-11. That review documents 12 race rows linking to the same profile and explains old US as a local-data issue; no nationality change inferred. The older photo discovery/coverage US value is stale, not competing current verified nationality.

Reinspected official HTML fixtures independently of proposed standings: scripts/fixtures/result-imports/nice-world-championship-2026.html and kona-2026.html both have /athlete/nick-thompson links, flag AU, place 11. First matches result 4428: swim 24:41, bike 2:17:46, run 1:10:22, total 3:56:04. Second matches result 4551: 51:36, 4:12:36, 2:51:52, total 8:01:13. Fixture filename is not used to infer race identity; existing source metadata/result linkage applies. Missing enrichment mapping does not invalidate this separate verified country/profile evidence.

## Conflicts and safety

Current 1167-profile catalog contains one exact local-name candidate for each proposed ID. No competing Petersen/Stage Nielsen/Nick Thompson profile was found; another Thompson profile is Kelly Thompson (ID 10286, CA), a distinct identity. The approved Mathias URL is unique in the mapping registry. Maja and Nick are absent there, so this review does not add or authorize enrichment mappings. No unresolved identity conflict remains on the inspected evidence. Owner approval of four ranking mappings is still required.

All 60 rankings, names, countries, points and current identity fields remain unchanged. All previous files and evidence preserved. No application/runtime edits.

## Validation and artifacts

- Current runtime catalog serializes identically to prior catalog baseline: 1167 profiles / 4592 results. Initial direct object comparison included undefined image properties absent from JSON; corrected JSON-to-JSON comparison PASS, no data edits.
- Existing IRONMAN/T100 registry tests: 19/19 PASS, including deterministic registry replay, country normalization and historical tuple validation.
- Maja's three independently observed tuples: exact local comparison PASS.
- git diff --check: PASS. Full release gate not rerun for a read-only review.
- identity-proposals.csv: all 60 rows, current versus proposed statuses kept separate.
- evidence-hashes.json: local evidence and registry fingerprints, not fabricated web HTML hashes.
- Test log: /tmp/300w-ironman-identity-tests-2026-10-22.log.

Only this new /tmp review directory and test log were created. No repository file was edited, no registry applied, no UI change, commit, push, deployment or remote mutation performed. STOP for owner review.
